items.title: Grafton Monster
items.fact: It stands around 7.5 feet (2.3 meters) tall and has an oversized chest.

items.title: Radscorpion
items.fact: Radscorpions are large, mutated scorpions commonly found in and around abandoned structures.

items.title: Diehards
items.fact: In Wastelanders, they returned under the leadership of Meg Groberg.

items.title: Chinese stealth armor
items.fact: The Chinese stealth armor is a light armor that grants the wearer a Sneak bonus of +5.

items.title: Doctor's bag
items.fact: A leather bag containing the tools used by a physician to heal crippled limbs, serving this purpose in both normal and hardcore modes.

items.title: Regulators
items.fact: In 2158, Jon Zimmerman hired mercenaries that displaced the original Regulators.

items.title: Vodka
items.fact: Vodka, as well as other hard liquor, provides a boost of +1 to Strength and Charisma but also gives a penalty of -1 to Intelligence.

items.title: Water Merchants
items.fact: The Water Merchants are a major caravan company operating out of the Hub in New California in 2161.

items.title: Yao guai
items.fact: Yao guai are extremely fast and powerful creatures, second only to deathclaws in terms of raw strength and speed.

items.title: Cargobot
items.fact: A cargobot is an automated, airborne cargo-delivery drone that transports government aid drops.

items.title: Legion recruit armor
items.fact: Legion recruit armor is a common light armor, supplied to recruit legionaries and to recruit decanus units.

items.title: Gatling gun
items.fact: A number of Mothman cultists in the Mothman Equinox event are armed with Gatling guns, and may drop the weapon upon death.

items.title: Westside Cooperative
items.fact: The Westside Cooperative is a farming commune and leadership council operating within the community of Westside in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: T-51 power armor
items.fact: Piezonucleic power armor - Unique T-51 torso potentially obtained as a quest reward for finishing the Cambridge Polymer Labs quest.

items.title: Blue Ridge Caravan Company
items.fact: The Blue Ridge Caravan Company is a powerful merchant company operating on the East Coast, and a major faction.

items.title: Steel ingot
items.fact: High grade ingots made of industrial-strength steel that were forged before the Great War in the mills located in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

items.title: Copper
items.fact: Copper is a component used to craft various electrical items, including weapon modifications, generators, lights, conduits and other settlement objects that require or produce power.

items.title: Yao guai
items.fact: Yao guai are creatures found in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

items.title: Crossbow
items.fact: Northwest of Foundation, a crossbow can be found below a rock face on top of a wooden staircase next to a skeleton.

items.title: Wood
items.fact: Moe Cronin in Diamond City sells shipments of 100 units of wood.

items.title: Kings
items.fact: Taking the King's School of Impersonation as their headquarters, the Kings subsequently claimed the surrounding area of Freeside as their territory.

items.title: Stingwing
items.fact: Stingwings appear to be a form of large, mutated insect, with protruding mandibles and a scorpion-like tail, ending in a bulbous and deadly stinger.

items.title: Swampfolk
items.fact: Swampfolk are a mutated type of human found in Point Lookout in 2277.

items.title: Floater
items.fact: The floater is a large, soft-bodied invertebrate, named after the flotation sacs that allow it to hover in the air.

items.title: Spoiled vegetables
items.fact: A more practical use for the spoiled vegetable is to convert it into raw fertilizer at a chemistry station, at a rate of 10 spoiled vegetables for one raw fertilizer.

items.title: Cassidy Caravans
items.fact: Cassidy Caravans is a caravan company founded, owned, and led by Rose of Sharon Cassidy that operates in New California and the Mojave Wasteland.

items.title: Robobrain
items.fact: Most pre-War robobrains carry sniper rifles and assault rifles, although units with City-Killer combat shotguns were also sighted.

items.title: White Glove Society
items.fact: The White Glove Society is a former Vault tribe employed by Robert House to run and maintain the Ultra-Luxe casino and hotel.

items.title: Miss Nanny
items.fact: The Miss Nanny design was geared mainly towards caretaking tasks, intended for parents of children of all ages.

items.title: Mutant hound
items.fact: These are dogs that have undergone major mutations from being exposed to the Forced Evolutionary Virus. Usually, they are accompanying super mutants.

items.title: Fish
items.fact: Live fish can be observed swimming in some bodies of water around the Mojave and Zion.

items.title: Wolf
items.fact: Wolves usually travel in packs and charge hastily at enemies to attack.

items.title: Publick Occurrences
items.fact: Publick Occurrences is a newspaper based in Diamond City in 2287, owned and operated by Piper Wright.

items.title: Tunneler
items.fact: They evolved into quadrupedal predators that lived and bred beneath the sands of the Divide.

items.title: Sensor module
items.fact:
It is used in the construction of the following items: 
- Bottlecap mine
- Powder charge 
- Fat Mine 
- Gas bomb 
- Auto-inject stimpak 
- Auto-inject super stimpak 
- Satchel charge…

items.title: Rabbit
items.fact: Outwardly, the radrabbit survived the Great War relatively unscathed, except for losing most of its fur.

items.title: Radstag
items.fact: Most radstags will flee on instinct when the player character or a predator approaches too close or attacks.

items.title: Grognak the Barbarian
items.fact: Reading this book permanently increases the player character's Melee Weapons skill by 3 points (4 with the Comprehension perk).

items.title: Mister Gutsy
items.fact: The Mister Gutsy is a combat model robot in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: Acadia
items.fact: Acadia is the name given to the isolated colony of synths led by the prototype synth DiMA residing on Mount Desert Island in Maine in 2287, so-named after the pre-War observatory they inhabit.

items.title: X-01 power armor
items.fact: X-01 power armor provides the greatest defense among all models of power armor featured in Fallout 4.

items.title: Trog
items.fact: Trogs are heavily deformed humans who have been mutated by the radiation and toxic pollutants from the many factories in Pittsburgh.

items.title: Bloodbug
items.fact: Bloodbugs are a species of mutated, ectoparasitic mosquitoes found in the Commonwealth in 2287.

items.title: Raider armor
items.fact: It has a Damage Resistance of +20%, which is lower than even the starting leather armor.

items.title: White Legs
items.fact: The White Legs are a raider tribe inhabiting the state of Utah in 2281, engaging in a campaign of pillaging and warfare against the native tribes of Zion Canyon on the behalf of Caesar's Legion.

items.title: Vault 101 utility jumpsuit
items.fact: The Vault 101 utility jumpsuit is a modified version of the standard Vault 101 jumpsuit designed for manual labor and routine repair.

items.title: Fixer
items.fact: This product was created by Med-Tek for temporarily curing addictions.

items.title: Ghost people
items.fact: Ghost people, also called locals and/or Villa inhabitants, are hostile mutated creatures found in the Sierra Madre.

items.title: Sentry bot
items.fact: Despite their intimidating strengths, they possess a glaring weakness - overheating.

items.title: Abraxo cleaner
items.fact: Abraxo cleaner is a pre-War cleaning agent produced by Abraxodyne Chemical. It can still be found throughout the Capital Wasteland 200 years after the Great War.

items.title: Water chip
items.fact: The water purification control chip, usually called just the water chip or water purifier chip, is the cornerstone of the Vault-Tec Corporation's water purification systems installed in Vaults.

items.title: Raiders
items.fact: Raiders are a type of faction, comprising multiple decentralized groups of nomadic bandits, outlaws, and thugs that occupy various locations throughout the Commonwealth.

items.title: Buffout
items.fact: Buffout is a consumable performance-enhancing drug that boosts both Strength and Endurance, in addition to a health increase of 60 HP.

items.title: Squirrel
items.fact: These squirrels have retained the general size and form of their pre-War counterparts.

items.title: Chainsaw
items.fact: A fully automatic melee weapon with sharp teeth able to shred virtually anything they come into contact with.

items.title: The Pack
items.fact: The hierarchy of the Pack is based on pop-cultural depictions of wolf packs, with their leader being referred to as the "alpha," they follow the rule of "survival of the fittest."

items.title: T-45d power armor
items.fact: Equipping the T-45d power armor provides a Damage Threshold of 22 as well as a bonus of +10 Radiation Resistance and a temporary +2 to Strength and -2 to Agility.

items.title: Abomination
items.fact: The results of the alien crew's genetic experiments on human abductees, Abominations are humans who have been irreversibly transformed by combining their DNA with that of the Zetans themselves.

items.title: REPCONN Aerospace
items.fact: Their headquarters and test site can still be found in the Mojave Wasteland.

items.title: Scoped .44 Magnum
items.fact: The scoped.44 Magnum is a very high-powered pistol. It has a very long effective range, which is further extended by the scope but also has a low rate of fire for a double-action revolver.

items.title: Tunnel Snakes
items.fact: The Tunnel Snakes were a juvenile delinquent gang active in Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: Centaur
items.fact: Only one giant evolved centaur can be found in the game, located in the Devil's Throat.

items.title: Crowbar
items.fact: As well as a weapon it enables the prying open of locked containers and stuck doors (through the "Use Inventory Item On" command).

items.title: Turbo
items.fact: Turbo appears as an inhaler of Jet hastily duct-taped to a can of HairStylez brand hairspray.

items.title: Skylanes Air
items.fact: Skylanes Air was an airline carrier that was known to operate in the United States before the Great War.

items.title: Yao guai
items.fact: Yao guai are a species of mutated bears that inhabit the Commonwealth, the Island and Nuka-World in 2287.

items.title: State of Utobitha
items.fact: The State of Utobitha is a remnant group of first and second generation super mutants led by Tabitha in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Three Families
items.fact: While Securitrons patrol the exterior roads of the Strip, they can only enter a casino to handle official business if invited by the ruling Family.

items.title: Rivet City security force
items.fact: The Rivet City security force is almost entirely comprised of citizens in good standing, who know how to handle firearms.

items.title: Floater
items.fact: Floaters are mutated creatures that are the product of experimentation with the Forced Evolutionary Virus.

items.title: Bloatfly
items.fact: Their carapaces are not particularly effective as a protection against any type of weapon.

items.title: Gorilla
items.fact: The gorilla is a synthetic creature found contained inside the terrariums of Institute BioScience in 2287.

items.title: Treeminders
items.fact: The Treeminders are a peaceful religious tribe that protects Oasis in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

items.title: Hermit crab
items.fact: They utilize vans as a stand-in for their shell, such as those bearing Lobster Grill logos.

items.title: Mirelurk king
items.fact: Mirelurk kings do not resemble the crablike mirelurks, instead appearing to be heavily-mutated frogs based on sounds they make and the webbing between their fingers and toes.

items.title: Wonderglue
items.fact: Wonderglue is a pre-War brand of glue that has retained its adhesive qualities.

items.title: Hydra
items.fact: Hydra is used to restore health to crippled limbs, making it especially useful in Hardcore mode where stimpaks or sleeping in a rented bed won't heal these injuries.

items.title: Duchess Gambit
items.fact: Boarding the Duchess Gambit at both the riverboat landing and the pier at Pilgrim's Landing serves as the respective travel point between the Capital Wasteland and Point Lookout game worlds…

items.title: Plasma gun
items.fact: The plasma gun is a versatile urban warfare weapon that can be used as a pistol, sniper rifle, semi-auto rifle, assault rifle, shotgun or even a flamethrower…

items.title: Eyebot
items.fact: The variant seen in Fallout 4 appears to be specifically designed for reconnaissance and surveillance, but is still often used to broadcast information and propaganda.

items.title: Spore plant
items.fact: Spore plants are creatures found in Arroyo and random encounters around Arroyo in 2241.

items.title: ArcJet Systems
items.fact: ArcJet Systems (also known simply as ArcJet) was a pre-War company which performed communications and propulsion work for both military and civilian contractors as early as 2063.

items.title: Enclave remnants
items.fact: The Enclave remnants are a unit of surviving Enclave soldiers who have entered the Commonwealth in 2287 to track down and recover the X-02 power armor stolen by a deserter known as the Black Devil.

items.title: Mutant hound
items.fact: Mutant hounds are dogs that have undergone a major mutation after being contaminated by the Forced Evolutionary Virus.

items.title: Sheepsquatch
items.fact:
Sheepsquatches are creatures found in Appalachia. ## Background
A cryptid stalking the Appalachian mountains, the Sheepsquatch myth was an obsession for many cryptid hunters…

items.title: Chinese stealth armor
items.fact: It was issued to the PLA's elite Crimson Dragoon troops as well as the "Black Ghost" counter-insurgency/terror units before and during the Great War.

items.title: Handmade rifle
items.fact: The handmade rifle is a powerful weapon that fills a niche similar to the assault rifle.

items.title: T-51b power armor
items.fact: The T-51b power armor is a type of armor in Fallout: New Vegas.

items.title: Legion ear
items.fact: Private Sexton at Camp Forlorn Hope is organizing a competition to collect them and will reward the Courier for bringing them to him.

items.title: Wine
items.fact: There is a very large cache of 25 wine in the Ultra-Luxe kitchen.

items.title: Flatwoods monster
items.fact: Flatwoods monsters, known before the War as the Green Monster, are extraterrestrial creatures encountered in Appalachia and expanded upon in the Invaders from Beyond update.

items.title: Robo-scorpion
items.fact: The unique X-42 giant robo-scorpion is a special model adorned with Saturnite armor plating, making it virtually impervious to small arms fire, but it is vulnerable against pulse weapons.

items.title: Chairmen
items.fact: The Chairmen are one of the Three Families on the New Vegas Strip in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Bottle cap
items.fact: The bottle cap is the main currency used in the Mojave Wasteland when dealing with NPCs.

items.title: Lyons' Pride
items.fact: Lyons' Pride (commonly truncated as the Pride) is a special tactical unit within Lyons' Brotherhood of Steel, composed of elite Brotherhood soldiers led by Sentinel Sarah Lyons in 2277.

items.title: Super-Duper Mart
items.fact: Super-Duper Mart was a pre-War retail corporation that operated a chain of grocery stores and supermarkets.

items.title: Enclave
items.fact: That year, this resurgent Enclave faction sent an expedition to the Commonwealth, seeking to recover any valuable materiel and establish a permanent base of operations in the region.

items.title: Alien
items.fact: The alien captain is a stronger variant of alien found in the Mojave Wasteland.

items.title: Mole rat
items.fact: Mole rats can often be found in large packs together with pig rats and giant rats, particularly in underground locations such as caverns or derelict vaults.

items.title: Gatling laser
items.fact: The Gatling laser is the most advanced weapon type for the Big Guns skill.

items.title: Hermit crab
items.fact: They don't fit through most doors and cannot mount obstacles.

items.title: Tesla rifle
items.fact: The Tesla rifle is a unique weapon in the Fallout 4 add-on Automatron, created by Ivey.

items.title: Deathclaw gauntlet
items.fact: The deathclaw gauntlet is a crafted Unarmed weapon in Fallout 3.

items.title: Gulper
items.fact: Gulpers also have the passive ability of slowly regenerating health.

items.title: Fragmentation grenade
items.fact: Almost every type of enemy can use these grenades, such as raiders, super mutants and Gunners.

items.title: Antidote
items.fact: A bottle with a home-brewed antidote that counteracts poison, created out of a radscorpion tail.

items.title: Bark scorpion
items.fact: Bark scorpions are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Vault 101 security armor
items.fact: Vault 101 security armor and Vault 101 security helmet are a suit of armor worn by the vault security officers.

items.title: Flower
items.fact: A Unity Rose, simply called a flower in the inventory, is a miscellaneous item in Fallout.

items.title: Buffout
items.fact: Buffout is a performance-enhancing drug that boosts both Strength and Endurance, in addition to a health increase of 60 HP.

items.title: Robobrain
items.fact: Robobrains can then be encountered in the Commonwealth and on the Island in 2287, respectively.

items.title: Grognak the Barbarian
items.fact: Reading this comic book permanently increases one's Melee Weapons skill by 1 (2 with Comprehension).

items.title: Mark of Caesar
items.fact: The item is a Legion denarius that has been turned into a necklace. It has a bull symbol and the words Legio Caesaris, Latin for Caesar's Legion.

items.title: Scorpion tail
items.fact: They are the tails taken from dead radscorpions, cut at the base where they meet the body, and they are prized for the poison sac it contains, which is used to make a poison antidote.

items.title: Chinese jumpsuit
items.fact: The Chinese jumpsuit and the Chinese commando hat are pieces of clothing in Fallout 3.

items.title: Radscorpion
items.fact: Radscorpions are mutated arachnids found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

items.title: Diamond City security
items.fact: Diamond City security is the main security force of Diamond City in 2287.

items.title: Fire ant
items.fact: Fire ants are creatures living in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

items.title: .50 cal machine gun
items.fact: The M2 Browning machine gun is a belt-fed automatic heavy weapon chambered for.50 caliber rounds.

items.title: Pitt raiders
items.fact: The Pitt raiders, also known as Ashur's army, are a group of slavers who rule over the Pitt slaves in the Pitt after the Scourge.

items.title: New California Republic
items.fact: The New California Republic (NCR) is a post-War federal republic founded in the namesake territory of New California in 2189.

items.title: Spore carrier
items.fact: When faced in combat, spore carriers are quick and agile, scampering directly toward their target where they swipe with claws and lunge into melee attacks.

items.title: Mirelurk queen
items.fact: They can also release mirelurk spawn like grenades, using them as a distraction while she kills the opponent.

items.title: Covenant
items.fact: The Covenant settlement is the culmination of her research, a prosperous community that is designed to attract dozens of visitors each week…

items.title: Night stalker
items.fact: Night stalkers are a genetic hybridization of the coyote and rattlesnake, displaying characteristics of both.

items.title: Vault jumpsuit
items.fact: All jumpsuits with the exception of those from Vault 11 have no Damage Threshold, but provide a bonus of +2 to Speech and Melee Weapons and can be repaired with other Vault jumpsuits.

items.title: Sorrows
items.fact: The Sorrows' culture is one of grace and communion with their natural environment, rather than a warrior-based one, though they are not completely pacifistic.

items.title: Gauss rifle
items.fact: The Gauss rifle is an advanced sniper rifle included in the Fallout 3 add-on Operation: Anchorage.

items.title: Robobrain
items.fact: Robobrains are a fairly common sight in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: Spoiled meat
items.fact: Spoiled meat will appear in the player character's inventory whenever a piece of cooked or raw meat has fully rotted.

items.title: Hologram
items.fact: They can be "destroyed" only by destroying or disabling their respective emitter. They can alternatively be reprogrammed to patrol different layers of the casino.

items.title: Dead Horses
items.fact: The Dead Horses appear only in the Fallout: New Vegas add-on Honest Hearts.

items.title: Trog
items.fact: Trogs are creatures encountered by the Lone Wanderer in the Pitt.

items.title: Cowboy repeater
items.fact: A lever-action rifle designed to chamber-fire the small-caliber.357 Magnum round.

items.title: Hellcat Company
items.fact: The Hellcat Company is a mercenary faction in the wasteland, with known operations in the Pitt and Appalachia.

items.title: Atom Cats
items.fact: The Atom Cats are a minor faction that draws inspiration from mid-1950s greasers, with leather outfits and a hotrod-themed paint job for their power armor.

items.title: The Family
items.fact: The Family is a gang of self-proclaimed vampires that live in Meresti Metro station, east of the settlement of Arefu, in Fallout 3.

items.title: Regulators
items.fact: The Regulators are a faction encountered in the Capital Wasteland.

items.title: Harbormen
items.fact: The present-day harbormen are descended from sailors, fishermen, and other residents of Mount Desert Island, including the coastal town of Bar Harbor.

items.title: Caesar's Legion armor
items.fact: Caesar's Legion armor is armor of various types in Fallout: New Vegas.

items.title: Rust Eagles
items.fact: The Rust Eagles perfect their craft by pit fighting in the Metal Dome.

items.title: T-51b power armor
items.fact: In Fallout 3, the T-51b power armor is a unique model of armor and can only be found in Fort Constantine.

items.title: Poseidon Oil
items.fact: Poseidon Oil was a subsidiary of Poseidon Energy before the Great War.
